been playing Elite on and off since beta 3, never really got involved in the community either so thats something I also want to change.. anyway I have started to get back into Elite and did a quick search for voice controls and came accross Voice attack. I was wondering, does anyone here use it? is it worth buying and how much better / worse is the game?

one of the selling points for me was voice commands star trek style, I imagine my self telling my ship to lock on to a target or go to warp or analyze an anomaly.. anyway is voice attack something I should be getting? what are your thought?

I have voice attack. The dev is super helpful. I had a bit of trouble with my setup so he had a look at what was happening and actually patched the program just for me. You don't get service like that anymore! As for whether or not it makes any difference to the experience, I would say yes. It's a lot more fun! Be prepared to spend some time tweaking things, but once everything is to your liking it is great fun controlling things with your voice.
Awesome. Thank you for replying. Edit: also I am glad to hear the Dev is helpful like that makes me happier to support them by buying it.
